name: Harvesting Windstones
summary: At Thendal Grove, Dalia the Collector asks you to gather raw windstones before their power fades. The ancient elemental energies of Zephras Isle are slowly dwindling.

sections.title: A Fading Island
sections.body: Zephras Isle still draws on wind magic, but its natural defenses are failing. Centuries ago, the wind elementals who shared the island with its elves vanished. Since then, the magic that sustains the land and its great anchor pylons has weakened. So Thendal Grove’s residents need every reserve of raw energy they can secure.

sections.title: The Value of Windstones
sections.body: Blue crystalline windstones lie scattered through Thendal Grove. Their brittle shells hold dense wind magic from ages past. They cannot sustain the island forever, yet they give its elves a dependable source of arcane power. Gathering raw clusters remains vital to daily life.

faq.answer: Windstones are blue crystalline deposits scattered around Thendal Grove. They hold concentrated raw wind energy, which the elves of Zephras Isle gather as magical fuel.

Dalia the Collector is an elven collector stationed in Thendal Grove on Zephras Isle. She organizes the gathering of vital raw resources, especially windstones, to support the island’s dwindling magical reserves.

faq.q: Why is the magic on Zephras Isle fading?
faq.answer: Centuries ago, the wind elementals who lived alongside the local elves vanished. Since then, the great anchor pylons’ magic, which sustains the island, has slowly drained away.

faq.q: Where did the wind elementals go?
faq.answer: No one knows where the wind elementals went. They vanished several centuries ago, leaving the island to slowly exhaust its remaining elemental reserves.
The great anchor pylons are ancient structures on Zephras Isle, imbued with powerful magic that sustains the land. Since the elementals vanished, that sustaining power has gradually weakened.

faq.q: Where do you find raw windstones?
faq.answer: Raw windstones are scattered across Thendal Grove on Zephras Isle, where they appear as glowing blue crystalline outcrops.

angles.text: As a Mage, you can see the elemental power held in windstones and how fragile magical ecosystems become when their elemental sources vanish.
As a miner, you gather valuable minerals and crystals from the wilds of Zephras Isle, including raw windstones.
